name: All-electric subsea systems
principle: Electric actuators replace hydraulic fluid and its lines, so trees need only power and signals. OneSubsea won a contract for Equinor's Fram Sør, 12 all-electric trees on four templates tied back to Troll C, which Equinor calls the first large-scale all-electric subsea production system.

process_steps.name: Power and signals through electric umbilical

performance.basis: four templates, tieback to Troll C

source.note: Offshore Engineer, Equinor picks OneSubsea all-electric subsea production system for North Sea field

advantages: No hydraulic fluid supply from the host
limitations: Water depth and start date not stated
